scope.notes: Confirmed V1 scope; the reference wave count does not force every level to have eight waves.

rage.engagedDefinition: One shared whole-army engagement flag: at least one damaging camp or hero has an alive attackable enemy in valid basic-attack range. Each hero then accrues rage once using its own role rate; aura camps and invulnerable targets alone do not create engagement.
rage.formula: for each hero: rage=min(100,rage+roleRate(sharedArmyEngaged)*unblockedCombatDt); roleRate uses lead/support; unblockedCombatDt=max(0,dt-min(dt,recoveryRemaining)); recoveryRemaining=max(0,recoveryRemaining-dt)

economy.referenceFinalBudgetEnemyPattern: prototype snapshot composition scaled by V1 density once for nonboss enemies, V1 base rewards, one unscaled boss; arithmetic reference only
economy.lateFullFieldPolicy: Late all-kill income may fund a full field; income timing, camp mix and level-three priorities remain tradeoffs. Full camps must not replace hero ultimates; validate rather than claim a hard cash deficit on every stage.
economy.rewardRevision: infantry stays 1; cavalry and elites/boss have lower integer rewards to temper density-related inflation
economy.referenceEnemyCompositionSource: historical 619-enemy training pattern before this density revision; independent of the current prototypeSnapshot

shield.name: 盾营
shield.slowApplication: continuous aura while alive enemy is inside range; damage attack cadence never gates the slow

catapult.name: 投石营
catapult.damageAndControlSeparation: Every alive enemy inside the explosion radius receives eligible impact slow; only the first six deterministic damage targets lose HP. The cap is public, identical at every level and never expanded by tactics.

fire_oil.name: 火油营
fire_oil.replaceRule: refresh existing field duration without restarting tick schedule; one source never double-stacks
fire_oil.effectiveDpsFormula: tickDamage/tickIntervalSec*min(1,fieldDurationSec/attackIntervalSec) for a stationary continuously covered target

war_drum.name: 战鼓营
war_drum.overlapRule: strongest aura bonus only, never multiply multiple drums

selectedLanePolicy.notes: On three-route maps choose only the highest-pressure two routes, then place two mines on each. Do not silently spawn six mines.

tacticSelection.insufficientPoolRule: Offer all remaining eligible tactics; never duplicate or offer unusable options.

modifierRules.damageMultipliers: Multiply distinct applicable modifiers once per hit; extra arrows use their own coefficient and obey per-cycle secondary-hit limits.
modifierRules.slowFactors: Strongest applicable factor wins, respecting class resistance and minimum speed factor; no additive freeze.
modifierRules.tacticScope: Only the selected hero or matching camp type; no implicit whole-army damage boost.
modifierRules.temporaryArmyDamageBuffRule: strongest applicable army buff, do not multiply same-category buffs
modifierRules.gateDamageReductionRule: strongest temporary factor, do not stack armor here

archer.rule: A cycle contains the main and volley projectiles; cap secondary pierce hits across the entire cycle.

modifierRules.slowResistanceRule: apply ordinary/elite/boss fraction and siege control fraction once; take strongest effective factor, never multiply independent slows

equipment.signatureNamingPolicy: Historical fiction and original wargame equipment; names are thematic, not claims of historical ownership.

metaProgression.normalLevelRequirement: Each level must be clearable at the recommended minimum hero and skill levels plus the recommended minimum main weapon only, with other three slots white Lv0, without daily repeat grinding. Initial resources are explicitly zero; initial tutorial levels are hero Lv1, skill Lv1, white Lv0.
metaProgression.recommendedTrainingPlan: First-clear campaign rewards fund a selected three-hero core; all fifteen heroes at maximum is optional long-term collection, not a clearance prerequisite.

starsReward.formula: rewardDelta=(firstWin?baseReward:0)+sum(floor(baseReward*0.1) for bonus star in [2,3] where previousHighestStar<star<=newHighestStar)

skillQueue.notes: Rage is the real cooldown. Reserving prevents duplicate clicks; rejected/cancelled queued requests never consume rage or enter recovery. Boss invulnerability blocks auto casting, and presentation scheduling never grants extra combat time.

v1Baseline.stageGrowthTierAssignment: Wei then Shu then Wu: explicit globalIndex 1..60, S01..S12 each bind five consecutive formal levels. The prototype training encounter is outside these sixty levels; replay does not reset tiers or reward flags. Never scale enemies from the actual selected hero level or equipment.

controlAndDisruption.enemyControlRule: multiply class resistance and siege control fraction once; strongest independent effective slow only

v1Baseline.bossVariantMultiplierPolicy: bossVariant.hpMultiplier contains the chapter act factor (0.75/0.82/0.90/1/1.12) and any explicitly documented variant adjustment. Do not apply bossActHpMultipliers again at runtime. No automatic wave-index HP growth.

battleSpeed.combatDtFormula: combatDt=visibleWallDt*battleSpeed; advance through fixed small substeps without dropping accumulated combat time
battleSpeed.speedChangeRule: Change only future wall-to-combat conversion; preserve timers, rage, queues and pending fixed steps.

alphaBalanceRevision.reason: Keep low-frequency capped area camps; reduce compounded elite durability and cavalry speed so earned-food control leaves room for hero ultimates.
alphaBalanceRevision.verifiedPolicy: mode6 two shields, one elite-priority crossbow, remaining archers; stage minimum training and main weapon only
alphaBalanceRevision.scope: 60 configured seeds and legal fixed policy; not proof that every party or player timing wins

analysisModels.damagePerSecond: damage/intervalSec (single target, no travel or lost shots)
analysisModels.expectedAliveCount: spawnRatePerSec*averageResidenceSec before kills or leaks (Little's law approximation)
analysisModels.campReturnTimeSec: cost/(extraDps*effectiveDamageToFoodConversion); needs level composition and cannot be inferred from raw DPS alone
analysisModels.prototypeCountCompositionRule: i%11===7 -> cavalry from wave>=3; i%15===10 -> armor from wave>=4 overrides cavalry; boss added separately in final wave
analysisModels.notes: These are reproducible arithmetic models, not a V1 combat simulation.
analysisModels.executeRule: Only explicitly eligible infantry may be executed. All other enemies take bounded numeric damage, even if an early-level hit happens to kill them.

acceptanceTargets.note: Seed win fractions describe scripted strategies under randomized lane/choice conditions, not human win rates.

levelContract.schemaExtensionRule: Adding a hero, enemy, tactic or difficulty profile extends the named dictionaries; campaign count remains in level data.
levelContract.partySizePolicy: Bind party size at battle start and apply the selected explicit elite/boss HP multiplier once; never double-apply at group and wave levels.
levelContract.bossVariantHpMultiplierMeaning: act factor times explicit variant factor, excluding stage tier and party size

levelReferenceSchema.catalogEnumExtensionRule: Current hero/enemy/camp/growthTier entries reflect this manifest; append dictionary and tier entries with a future manifest instead of treating the sixty-level snapshot as an eternal cap.
